name: Assets
description: Total economic resources owned by the business

name: Current Assets
description: Cash, equivalents, receivables, and other liquid assets

name: Cash & Digital Wallets
description: Physical cash and digital wallet balances

name: Cash on Hand
description: Petty cash and cash reserves for daily operations

name: Digital Wallets
description: Local e-wallets and instant payment balances

name: Bank Accounts
description: Checking and savings operating bank accounts

name: Primary Operating Bank Account
description: Primary business checking account

name: Secondary Operating Bank Account
description: Secondary bank account or digital bank

name: International Platforms & Gateways
description: Foreign currency and international payment balances

name: PayPal Balance
description: PayPal business balance

name: Wise Balance
description: Wise multi-currency balance

name: Stripe Holding
description: Pending balance in payment processors before payout

name: Accounts Receivable
description: Outstanding client invoices and platform funds

name: Client Invoices Receivable
description: Unpaid invoices issued to clients

name: Platform Escrow Balances
description: Funds held in escrow on freelance platforms (Upwork, Fiverr)

name: Prepaid Expenses
description: Advance payments for services such as annual software subscriptions

name: Fixed Assets
description: Long-term tangible assets used in freelance operations

name: Computer & Electronic Equipment
description: Laptops, workstations, monitors, and peripherals

name: Audio Visual & Studio Gear
description: Cameras, microphones, and studio production equipment

name: Office Furniture & Workstation
description: Desks, ergonomic chairs, and office setup

name: Accumulated Depreciation
description: Contra asset reducing the book value of fixed assets

name: Liabilities
description: Obligations and debts owed to third parties

name: Current Liabilities
description: Debts and obligations due within one year

name: Accounts Payable
description: Unpaid vendor bills and invoices

name: Credit Card Payable
description: Outstanding business credit card balances

name: Unearned Revenue
description: Client retainers and project deposits received in advance

name: Taxes Payable
description: Accrued income and sales tax liabilities

name: PayLater & Short-term Loans
description: Outstanding SPayLater, GoPay Later, Kredivo, and short-term microloans

name: Equity
description: Owner's residual interest in the business

name: Owner's Capital
description: Capital contributed to the business by the owner

name: Owner's Drawings
description: Withdrawals made by the owner for personal use

name: Retained Earnings
description: Cumulative net income retained from prior periods

name: Current Year Earnings
description: Net income or loss for the current fiscal year

name: Revenue
description: Earnings generated from professional services and products

name: Professional Service Revenue
description: Income earned from client projects and consulting

name: Software & Web Development Income
description: Revenue from engineering, web development, and coding projects

name: Design & Creative Service Income
description: Revenue from UI/UX, branding, and graphic design

name: Consulting & Advisory Income
description: Hourly consulting, technical audits, and mentoring sessions

name: Retainer & Support Revenue
description: Recurring monthly retainer and maintenance contracts

name: Digital Products & Royalty Revenue
description: Passive income from digital assets, courses, and content

name: Digital Product & Template Sales
description: Sales of templates, code libraries, themes, and UI kits

name: Course & Content Royalties
description: Royalties from educational videos, e-books, and workshops

name: Cost of Services
description: Direct costs incurred to deliver client projects

name: Subcontractors & Freelancers
description: Payments to third-party contractors and assistants

name: Client Project Asset Licenses
description: Fonts, stock assets, and plugins purchased for specific projects

name: Client Hosting & Infrastructure
description: Cloud hosting and domain fees directly billable to client projects

name: Operating Expenses
description: General overhead and administrative expenses

name: Communication & Workspace
description: Internet, phone, utilities, and desk rental

name: Internet & Mobile Phone
description: High-speed broadband and mobile connectivity

name: Co-Working & Office Rent
description: Desk rental, co-working space passes, and utilities

name: Software & Cloud Subscriptions
description: Recurring software tool and cloud subscriptions

name: Developer & Infrastructure Tools
description: GitHub, Vercel, JetBrains, Docker, and developer tools

name: Design & Creative Tools
description: Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Framer, and design software

name: AI Services & Subscriptions
description: ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Cursor, Midjourney, and AI APIs

name: Productivity & Collaboration Software
description: Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and password managers

name: Marketing & Portfolio
description: Website hosting, personal domains, and advertising

name: Personal Domain & Web Hosting
description: Portfolio website hosting and custom domain registrations

name: Advertising & Promotion
description: Social media ads, search ads, and job board promotion

name: Banking & Processing Fees
description: Financial service charges and platform commission fees

name: Bank Service Charges
description: Monthly bank account maintenance and wire transfer fees

name: Payment Gateway Fees
description: Transaction percentage fees on Stripe, PayPal, and digital wallets

name: Platform Service Commissions
description: Marketplace fees and service cuts (Upwork, Fiverr service fees)

name: Depreciation & Maintenance
description: Equipment repairs, servicing, and scheduled depreciation

description: Hardware maintenance, screen replacements, and battery repairs

name: Depreciation Expense
description: Periodic depreciation allocation for laptops and workstation equipment

name: Professional Development
description: Education, books, and professional skill enhancement

name: Books & Technical Publications
description: Industry books, e-books, and research subscriptions

name: Courses, Conferences & Certifications
description: Online courses, conference tickets, and professional exam fees

name: Personal & Living Expenses
description: Everyday personal living costs and household expenses

name: Food & Groceries
description: Daily meals, groceries, coffee, and food delivery services

name: Transportation & Commute
description: Fuel, toll charges, parking, ride-hailing, public transit, and vehicle maintenance

name: Household & Personal Supplies
description: Home toiletries, cleaning supplies, and everyday personal essentials

name: Housing & Rent
description: Apartment or house rental, community fees, and residential maintenance

name: Health & Wellness
description: Medications, doctor visits, gym memberships, and personal health insurance

name: Entertainment & Lifestyle
description: Movies, streaming subscriptions, hobbies, recreation, and social outings

description: Non-operational gains, losses, and interest

description: Interest earned on bank deposits

description: Losses from foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations

description: Realized losses from foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations

name: Unrealized Foreign Exchange Loss
description: Unrealized losses from foreign currency revaluations

description: Rounding differences from foreign exchange conversions

name: Income Tax Expense
description: National and local business income tax expenses
